chunks: Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Mansour Bin Hazim, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:

Ismail (peace be upon him) was named 'Truthful of the Promise' because he promised a man to meet him in a specific place, so he waited for him in that place for a year. Therefore, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, named him 'Truthful of the Promise'. Then he said: The man came to him after that, so Ismail (peace be upon him) said to him: 'I did not cease waiting for you'.

key_terms.صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ: Truthful of the Promise (a title for Ismail)

ai.seo_question: Why was Prophet Ismail known as 'Truthful of the Promise'?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from Al-Kafi underscores the virtue of 'Sadiq al-Wa'd' by illustrating Prophet Ismail’s (AS) unwavering fidelity to his word, waiting a full year in a specific location for a man he had promised to meet. This narrative serves as a practical model for believers, emphasizing that true truthfulness involves not just making promises but rigorously fulfilling them with patience and constancy, a trait highly valued in the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings on character.

en.hubeali:
Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Mansour Bin Hazim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘But rather Ismail<sup>as</sup> was named as ‘truthful of the promise’ because he<sup>as</sup> promised a man (to be) in a particular place, so he<sup>asws</sup> waited for him in that place for a year. Therefore Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Named him<sup>as</sup> as ‘The truthful of the promise’’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The man did come to him<sup>as</sup> after that, so Ismail<sup>as</sup> said to him: ‘I<sup>as</sup> did not cease waiting for you’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ibn abu ‘Umayr has narrated from Mansur ibn Hazim from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Isma’il is called the truthful in his promises; he promised a man to meet him at a certain place and Isma’il waited for him at that place for one year. Thus, Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, named him the truthful in his promise. The Imam then said, ‘The man then came at that place and Isma’il said to him, “I am still waiting for you.’””
